Name: Just Walk
Author: PureWinter
Description:
[Nexus port of one of my first Stardew CF mods.]
Trying to make new constructables and it takes Robin too long to get to her desk?
Testing custom NPC pathing?

Press 1 on your keyboard (not the number pad, just the top row) and you will see a notification: [img width=511,height=158]https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_ab294f48-6c17-4f1a-a75d-9f7a480d6a43.png[/img]

This makes NPCs start walking a lot faster towards wherever they are going to. 
It does come with a config but be warned if you crank it up there is a chance of strange or unwanted behavior. The mod is intended to be used with the settings it ships with. :)

[img]https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_4a7a051a-b032-45eb-aa32-c3f7e294cd92.png[/img]

Feel free to change the toggle key in this config to what you prefer! (It's in the mods folder directly in this mod, under the config json. A normal text editor is fine- mine is a themed notepad++.)
